adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly changes the Disqus importer from creating a local post with a permalink and preserved metadata to scraping the remote thread link: `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` replaces `PostCreator.new(... raw: "[[Permalink](#{t[:link]})]", created_at: ..., category: ...)` with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` performs network I/O (`open(url).read`) and runs `ruby-readability` to extract `doc.content`, and it does not pass along `created_at` (or the removed category option). This is a real, diff-grounded behavioral/scope change concern rather than a clearly provable defect by itself.
